messages:
sophie_support: Escalation from a large fintech customer. iOS app (v1.4.3) sees SSE stream cut mid-response when user moves out of office wifi to cellular. app receives ~70% of JSON then connection closed, they were charged for partial output and want a mitigation ASAP.

sophie_support: Customer log snippet: they start a long generation (~6s), toggle wifi off ~3-4s into stream, next they see a flurry of TCP retransmits then FIN. They attached client packet capture and an app log with socket error ECONNABORTED.

sophie_support: Affected region: us-west-2, single AZ, observed ~12 times in last 48h for this customer. SDK: mobile-sdk-ios 1.4.3 (embedded networking stack).

maria_sdk: thx. do we know which infra timeout would drop an idle backend connection during a short pause? LB idle? proxy?

evan_sre: preliminary check: ALB connect-timeout default is 30s on that stack. however the sequence here looks like: client pauses during link switch, TCP session enters TIME_WAIT or gets reset by OS, client attempts a TLS renegotiate which times out ~12-15s, meanwhile ALB tears backend. so client reconnects but new request hits a new worker which returns 400 because generation id/state was ephemeral. result: partial tokens billed.

sophie_support: customer notes that when they retry quickly the app shows a new response rather than resuming. they'd prefer resume semantics or at least not charge for partials if we didn't deliver final result.

maria_sdk: two paths: (A) infra: raise idle timeout on streaming route and add periodic 8s lightweight heartbeat bytes from runtime-to-LB to keep tunnel alive; (B) sdk: add short TCP/socket keepalive and implement chunk-resume with idempotency token so client can ask to resume from last byte. (B) is larger but ideal.

evan_sre: agree. short-term: we can flip ALB idle timeout to 90s for streaming routes in a canary AZ and add a minimal heartbeat in runtime to emit "\n" every 8s when stream is open but silent. low risk. long-term: implement resume token for SSE chunks plus billing protection.

julie_cs: customer asked: will we proactively refund partial bills? they said it's urgent for their legal/finance team.

sophie_support: offered to credit the invoice for affected calls as a one-off while we remediate. they accepted. raising to P1 for the session owner to track until fix.

maria_sdk: i'll ship a tiny runtime patch that emits invisible keepalive bytes for streams with expected latency >2s. will open PR (runtime#482) and land to staging today. also propose adding 'streaming' route tag so infra can selectively increase idle_timeout.

evan_sre: will apply ALB timeout bump to az-b canary in us-west-2 in the next 90 minutes and run a simulated wifi->cell handoff using our network flapping harness (macOS location switch + Charles) to reproduce. test script toggles wifi off at 3s into a 6s generation to match customer repro.

maria_sdk: small note: mobile OS often aggressively kills sockets when switching networks which triggers client-side aborts immediately; we should also recommend SDK retries/backoff tuning to customers (reduce app-level abort threshold from 10s -> 25s) so the app allows TLS renegotiation to finish. document to include suggested settings.

sophie_support: customer wants ETA. please provide timeline and keep them looped in.

maria_sdk: ETA: canary ALB change in 1.5h, runtime keepalive to staging in 3h, rollback plan in place. full rollout after canary validation in 24-36h.

evan_sre: testing notes: during simulated toggle we observed the same partial-chunk + FIN when ALB idle_timeout=30s and no runtime heartbeat. with idle_timeout=90s + heartbeat every 8s, connection remained alive and client reconnected to same worker in 8/10 runs. two failures were due to client OS killing socket immediately (no fix possible server-side) but overall success rate acceptable for rollout.

tony_incidentbot: [alert] change request: ALB idle_timeout increase scheduled for us-west-2 az-b. approvals pending from infra owners.

sophie_support: told customer: we are applying canary infra change + runtime heartbeat, offering credits for affected calls; we'll follow up after canary validation with a full schedule. customer accepted.

maria_sdk: follow-ups: 1) add documentation in SDK guide for mobile network switches and recommended client-side abort/backoff tuning; 2) add billing policy note for partial-stream refunds (manual until resume token implemented); 3) track runtime PR#482 and infra change request ID #ALB-7823.

evan_sre: i'll post results of canary tests and attach pcap diffs. if infra approves, we'll roll to other AZs tomorrow morning.

sophie_support: marking this thread as P1 and assigning to session owner. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
